astronauts.name: Yuri Gagarin
astronauts.bio: First human in space. Single 108 minute orbit that opened crewed spaceflight.

astronauts.name: Valentina Tereshkova
astronauts.bio: First woman in space. Solo flight of almost three days aboard Vostok 6.

astronauts.name: Neil Armstrong
astronauts.bio: Commander of Apollo 11 and first person to walk on the Moon.

astronauts.name: Sally Ride
astronauts.bio: First American woman in space and later a physics educator and advocate.

astronauts.name: Chris Hadfield
astronauts.bio: Canadian commander of the ISS known for science outreach from orbit.

astronauts.name: Sunita Williams
astronauts.bio: Long duration ISS veteran and holder of multiple spacewalk records for women.

astronauts.name: Tim Peake
astronauts.bio: First British ESA astronaut to live aboard the ISS.

astronauts.name: Wang Yaping
astronauts.bio: Second Chinese woman in space and first to teach a lesson from orbit.
